metadata.title: Simulated Bundestagswahl prediction
metadata.note: This is a simulated projection for demonstration purposes, not an official forecast. Methodology: vote shares are hypothetical; seats are allocated proportionally among parties passing the 5% threshold and rounded to integer seats to match the chosen total seats.

parameters.seat_allocation_method: proportional (share of valid votes for parties >= threshold), simple rounding with final adjustment to match total seats

CDU/CSU + FDP + Greens.note: Three-party coalition with center-right and Greens; traffic-light label not applicable

SPD + Greens + FDP.note: Center-left coalition (SPD-Greens-FDP) would have a stable majority in this simulation

CDU/CSU + SPD.note: Grand coalition (CDU/CSU + SPD) would also form a majority

CDU/CSU + FDP.note: CDU/CSU + FDP alone would fall short of a majority

confidence.reason: Synthetic scenario; not based on polling aggregation or statistical model. Use only for UI/demo purposes.
